name: Abu Mena
description: Abu Mena lies in the desert about 50 km southwest of Alexandria, where an early Christian pilgrimage town grew up around the tomb of the martyr Menas, who died in A.D. 296. Little still stands, but the foundations of the great basilica, baptistry, streets, houses and workshops are easy to trace. Rising groundwater once threatened the ruins, and the site came off the danger list in 2025.
